name: Cohere

freeTier.note: Trial keys are rate limited and monthly-capped; production keys are billed. The API does not state which kind a key is in a machine-readable way, so the quota type stays UNKNOWN until verified by the operator.

notes: Uses Cohere's OpenAI-compatibility surface; if it is unavailable for a key the adapter reports a clear invalid_request rather than silently falling back to a different protocol.
